::: {.chapeau}
I work on how generative systems produce signs that have *already resolved
their interpretant* — and on what that pre-resolution does to the university as
a site of interpretation.
:::

PhD in semiotics (UQAM, 2022), lecturer at UQAM, UQAT and UQO. My postdoctoral
project, **Interpretive Cooperation in the Age of Algorithmic Semiosis**, is
built around three gestures: mapping probabilistic reliefs, inhabiting the
semiotic silence they short-circuit, and instituting the conditions for
semiotic resistance in higher education.
